artworks.title: The Death of Orpheus
artworks.description: Lévy's maenads overwhelm the Thracian bard — the Ciconian fury Ovid tells when pipes and tambourines drowned the lyre that had moved stones.

artworks.title: Orpheus
artworks.description: Waterhouse's Orpheus at the threshold — harp and head bound for the Hebrus, on the eve of the reunion his living glance had forfeited.
